mechanism_narrative: Sustained low FEDFUNDS (below 2%) signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE rise exceeding 0.3 percentage points in 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting investors to anticipate slower growth and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns despite UNRATE crossing the threshold, or t-test p-value > 0.05 in a 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained low FEDFUNDS (<2%) combined with rising GDPC1 (demand) creates a positive feedback loop, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% and GDPC1 growth > 5% in prior month
failure_condition: Positive returns without the FEDFUNDS-GDPC1 interaction, or IC < 0.03 over a 1-month period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in INDPRO (supply) intensifies demand pressures, boosting equity valuations and generating positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Negative 60-day returns in late-cycle expansion despite INDPRO decline, or IC < 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained CPIAUCSL above 225 (3-month average) signals persistent inflation, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: Positive returns despite CPIAUCSL dropping below 225, or IC < 0.03 over a 1-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in PAYEMS (employment) exceeding 131,190 + 100 and a concurrent UNRATE drop below 8.5% signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS surge of over 100 units and UNRATE decline below 8.5%
failure_condition: Positive returns without the PAYEMS-UNRATE interaction, or IC < 0.03 over a 1-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO (supply) below its 3-month average signals potential overvaluation, prompting equity purchases and positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO recovers but 5-day returns remain positive, or IC < 0.03 over a 6-month period.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained FEDFUNDS rise above 4% signals higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive returns during monetary tightening despite FEDFUNDS rise, or IC < 0.03 over a 1-quarter period.
